snippet.title: Plague Island DLC for the original ATOM RPG
snippet.description:
Trailer for the newest DLC drop for the original ATOM RPG! 

Take wing and descend upon Plague Island - a brand new world map brimming with new characters, quests and locations to explore! Find it on Steam, GOG and more..!

Check it out here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/552620/view/671757096278032783

Plague Island is a story-driven DLC for the original ATOM RPG that introduces new locations, storylines, characters, and a host of other exciting gameplay features.

The plot takes you from a small airfield near Fogelevka to a new world map: an island where a Gwon-Jo-controlled settlement is grappling with a mysterious disease outbreak.

Meet 30+ new characters from all walks of life and explore 17 unique locations.

Help or hinder them by completing more than a dozen new questlines, some dialogue-driven, others requiring you to fight, or explore the depths of a sealed pre-war bunker.
